remarks: Enjoy coastal living at its best in this beautifully maintained, spacious end-unit townhome offering sweeping 180-degree South Bay views, desirable southern exposure, and exceptional privacy. Natural light pours in from sunrise through late afternoon, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere. Direct entry from the private garage leads into a dramatic living room featuring soaring ceilings, beautiful bamboo hardwood floors, and a cozy fireplace. The updated kitchen features a Viking stove, while three outdoor balconies provide wonderful spaces to relax and entertain, each showcasing unobstructed views. New French sliding doors add an elegant touch while enhancing the home's connection to it
